commands.summary: Plan and execute the change event series status reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor change event series status apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: changes an event series' publication status; setting to draft/sales_closed immediately stops further public ticket sales
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the checkout form elements ETL stream
examples: pm tickettailor checkout form elements list --json

commands.summary: Run the checkout forms ETL stream
examples: pm tickettailor checkout forms list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the confirm order payment received reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor confirm order payment received apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: marks an order (typically an offline/manual payment method) as paid, releasing its tickets from pending status
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create check in reverse-ETL action

flags.name: issued_ticket_id
flags.summary: Required issued ticket id record field.

examples: pm tickettailor create check in apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: checks an attendee's issued ticket in (or out, when quantity is -1) at the door; low-risk operational mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create discount reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor create discount apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a discount code redeemable at checkout; low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create event series reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor create event series apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new event series (a recurring/template event definition); low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create issued membership reverse-ETL action

flags.name: membership_type_id
flags.summary: Required membership type id record field.

examples: pm tickettailor create issued membership apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: issues a new membership directly to a member; low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create issued ticket reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor create issued ticket apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: issues a new ticket directly (bypassing checkout), consuming inventory from either a ticket type or an existing hold; low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create membership type reverse-ETL action

flags.name: valid_from_type
flags.summary: Required valid from type record field.

flags.name: valid_to_type
flags.summary: Required valid to type record field.

examples: pm tickettailor create membership type apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new membership type template; low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create product reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor create product apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new sellable add-on product; low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create voucher reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor create voucher apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new voucher and its redeemable codes; low-risk additive external mutation, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete discount reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor delete discount apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a discount code; any customer relying on the code at checkout will see it rejected
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete event series reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor delete event series apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes an event series and every event occurrence within it; destructive, approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete hold reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor delete hold apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: releases a hold, returning its reserved tickets to public sale immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete membership type reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor delete membership type apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a membership type; any issued membership referencing it is orphaned
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete product reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor delete product apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a sellable product; it becomes unavailable at checkout immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete voucher reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor delete voucher apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: permanently deletes a voucher and every un-redeemed code issued under it
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update discount reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor update discount apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing discount code's name, code, or usage limit; changing the code invalidates any already-shared link using the old code
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update event series reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor update event series apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing event series' public-facing name/description/currency
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update issued membership reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor update issued membership apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing issued membership's holder details or validity window
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update order reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor update order apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing order's buyer contact/address details
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update product reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor update product apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing product's name, price, or description, directly changing checkout pricing for it
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update voucher reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor update voucher apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: mutates an existing voucher's value or expiry, directly changing what every un-redeemed code is worth
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the void issued membership reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor void issued membership apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: voids an issued membership, invalidating it immediately for entry/redemption
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the void issued ticket reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor void issued ticket apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: voids an issued ticket, invalidating it for entry; optionally returns its inventory to a hold rather than public sale
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the void voucher code reverse-ETL action
examples: pm tickettailor void voucher code apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: voids a single voucher code, invalidating it for redemption immediately
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the voucher codes ETL stream
examples: pm tickettailor voucher codes list --json
pm tickettailor vouchers list --json
